name: P.L.U.T.O. Rescue (Pet Lovers United Together as One)
region_note: STATEN ISLAND (Staten Island-based / SI-serving dog rescues)
notes: All-volunteer 501(c)(3) no-kill on Staten Island. Uses the Merry Mutts Play & Stay facility (654A Sharrotts Rd, SI 10309) plus volunteer fosters. Dogs HW-tested; cats FIV/FeLV-tested; all vetted + altered + microchipped before adoption. Adoption donation: dog/puppy $180, purebred dog/puppy $280, cat/kitten $80 (incl. full vetting). App reviewed -> home visit -> paperwork at the visit. Mail: PO Box 140889, Staten Island 10314. Solid SI option beyond Louie's Legacy. Phone: (no public phone; contact via FB/site) Email: (via Facebook message / site) Intake: Adopt/foster via site, Petfinder & Adoptapet Intake: Saturday adoption events Intake: application -> home visit
